Vendored so the page loads nothing from other sites (CSP script-src self).
- gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js: GSAP 3.12.5 (GreenSock standard licence, free to use).
- posthog.js: posthog-js 1.447.12, dist/array.no-external.js (MIT/Apache-2.0, see posthog-LICENSE).
Fonts in ../fonts: Inter and Big Shoulders Display variable, latin + latin-ext, from @fontsource-variable (SIL OFL 1.1).
